description.value: Delicado's is a lively southwestern-style cafe and deli in downtown Nanaimo, serving freshly made wraps, burritos, enchiladas, homemade soups, and colourful salads prepared on-site daily. An in-house mini-market stocks specialty items like artisan hot sauces, fresh salsas, and hummus — handy for cyclists looking to resupply beyond just a meal. It is part of a small BC franchise with multiple Vancouver Island locations, giving the downtown Nanaimo outlet a well-practised kitchen and a wide, customisable menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Nanaimo Downtown location at 238 Wesley Street with phone 250-753-6524, matching OSM tags exactly. The homepage explicitly advertises 'DINE IN / TAKEOUT' and states the deli case has 'all our eat-in favorites, salads, and side dishes available to go,' confirming takeout; multiple named vegetarian menu items (Veggie roll-up, Falafel, Garden Medley, Veggie Thai) confirm vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill was found anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM cuisine tag is 'mexican' but the website consistently describes the food as 'southwestern' — not specifically Mexican cuisine.
Business name on website is 'Delicado's Deli' whereas OSM records it simply as 'Delicado's'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible southwestern cafe and deli in downtown Nanaimo with a confirmed current website, matching contact details, and active menu.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian options: Veggie roll-up (avocado, beans, tomato), Falafel roll-up, Garden Medley whole-wheat wrap, and Veggie Thai spicy wrap

wow_evidence: part of a small BC franchise with multiple Vancouver Island locations

price.label: Cheap eats
price.signal: All mains $7–$13; deli format; explicitly 'reasonably priced'
